title: Consequences of property (A) for the small pushforward
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma derives three consequences of property (A) for a morphism of schemes: the small pushforward reflects injections and surjections, the unit f_{small}^{-1}f_{small,*}F -> F is surjective, and the pushforward is faithful (statement lines 5737-5757, with property (A) delivered verbatim as a context span from lines 5708-5726). The proof uses the local description supplied by property (A) to split the sections over an etale U into a product over open and closed pieces of base changes (proof lines 5759-5787), which yields both reflection statements, and then deduces the remaining two clauses formally (proof lines 5789-5792). The non-formal content is the direct summand computation in the first part. The claim is H2: one local computation plus a formal consequence.
